profile.name: Arush Gumber
profile.roleLine: Researcher, engineer, founder · in that order, depending on the day

connect.label: Request résumé
connect.subject: Let's connect
connect.body:
Hi Arush,

I came across your portfolio and would like to connect. Could you please share your résumé?

Thanks!

projects.kicker: Vision · Gov. AI Challenge · now NivionAI
projects.title: Few-Shot Visual Search in Satellite Imagery
projects.subtitle: NCIIPC Startup India AI Grand Challenge (PS-03)
projects.problem: Locate rare, tiny targets (<0.1% of image) from a handful of labels.
projects.built: A multi-stage detect-then-verify pipeline: weak-label expansion, ensembled detection, and feature/geometry verification to kill false positives.
projects.metricLabel: over baseline · Top 3 of 670+ · Stage 2 cleared · ₹38L

projects.title: LangGraph Multi-Agent Stock Reranker
projects.subtitle: Implicit-feedback collaborative filtering for weekly equity ranking
projects.problem: Rank weekly Indian equities as regimes shift and signals decay.
projects.built: A bounded LangGraph multi-agent reranker over a tuned blend of 7 expert rankers, with LLM sub-agents injecting macro, news and fundamentals.
projects.metricLabel: cumulative · Sharpe 1.45 · beat Nifty 50 in 28/41 wks

projects.title: Algorithmic Trading System
projects.subtitle: NSE tick data · Kite API · in development
projects.problem: Trade NSE intraday in real time, from signal to execution to monitoring.
projects.built: LSTM/Transformer forecasters on tick data with sentiment features, Kite API execution and a live monitoring dashboard, handling 1,000+ ticks per second.

projects.title: DroidPlanner: JEPA World Model
projects.subtitle: Multi-step latent consistency & spatial aggregation for planning
projects.problem: Plan offline, goal-conditioned, from latent dynamics, stably.
projects.built: Extended LeWM-style JEPA with a K=3 latent-consistency loss and a PatchSpatialAggregator restoring ViT patch info via gated pyramid fusion.

projects.title: REDACT: Data Privacy Platform
projects.subtitle: Smart India Hackathon 2024 · Top 2 / 100+
projects.problem: Redact PII across text, images and documents reliably.
projects.built: A multimodal redaction engine with BERT-based NLP and few-shot domain adaptation for legal/medical docs, behind a secure pipeline.

projects.title: Multimodal Price Prediction
projects.subtitle: Amazon ML Challenge 2025 · Rank 54 / 20,000+
projects.problem: Predict product price from image + text without price lookups.
projects.built: Fused CLIP ViT-B/32 and DINOv2 visual embeddings with TF-IDF text via cross-attention; global embedding caches for 5× inference speedup.

projects.title: Underwater Acoustic Event Detection
projects.subtitle: Unified framework · manuscript in preparation
projects.problem: Assess biodiversity and vessel activity from long marine soundscapes.
projects.built: Standardized multiple marine acoustic datasets and a joint detection framework over long-duration audio.

projects.title: MusicBind: Cross-Modal Song Retrieval
projects.subtitle: Research prototype
projects.problem: Align audio, text, image and graph in one space for retrieval.
projects.built: A PyTorch cross-modal system in a hyperbolic embedding space with GNNs, evaluated on GTZAN.

projects.title: Custom RISC-V Assembler & Simulator
projects.subtitle: RV32I ISA · course project (Prof. Sujay Deb)
projects.problem: Assemble and execute the full RV32I instruction set, correctly.
projects.built: A complete assembler and simulator with full instruction encoding, memory management and a CI/CD pipeline.

projects.title: BidBazar: Real-time Auction Platform
projects.subtitle: Concurrent bidding · course project (Prof. Mukesh Mohania)
projects.problem: Resolve concurrent bids for 1000+ users without races.
projects.built: A real-time auction platform with SQL-optimized bid resolution, auto-bidding and sniping protection.

projects.title: Marvel Birds: Game Engine
projects.subtitle: Physics engine · course project (Prof. Sambuddho Chakravarty)
projects.problem: Build a 2D physics engine with clean, extensible architecture.
projects.built: A LibGDX and Box2D physics engine with collision detection, using Factory and Observer design patterns.

publications.title: Uncovering the Latent Potential of Deep Intermediate Representations
publications.authors: A. Batra, A. Gumber*, A. Khandelwal*, J. Khemani, A. Gupta
publications.summary: LOES selects task-discriminative layer subspaces under orthogonality/isotropy constraints, with a geometric fine-tuning loss; gains over transfer baselines grow with depth.

publications.title: Catching AI-Generated Code at Scale: A Lightweight and Interpretable Detector for the LLM Era
publications.authors: A. Batra, K. Thukral, D. Sharma*, A. Khandelwal*, A. Gumber*
publications.summary: NanoDroid, a 5.1M-parameter detector at 90.8% weighted F1, rivaling UniXcoder with about 25× fewer parameters.
publications.note: An earlier version appeared at ICML 2026 workshops.

publications.title: M-SCAN: A Multistage Framework for Lumbar Spinal Canal Stenosis Grading Using Multi-View Cross Attention
publications.authors: A. Batra, A. Gumber, A. Kumar
publications.summary: Automated MRI spinal-stenosis grading at 0.971 AUROC with YOLO detection and multi-view cross-attention.

publications.title: TOAM-YOLO: A Tiny Object-Aware Multi-Expert YOLO Framework for Diverse Domains
publications.authors: V. Sharma*, A. Batra*, A. Gumber*, R. Gupta, A. Gupta
publications.summary: Hessian-curvature and Fourier-frequency experts with three-level attention, plug-and-play on YOLOv11/v12; consistent mAP gains on five tiny-object and blood-cell benchmarks for only 0.75M extra parameters.

publications.title: When the Label Measures the Estimator: Threshold Leakage in Estimate-Scaled Evaluation Labels
publications.venueLong: TAE: Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
publications.summary: When labels are scaled by an estimate, estimator error leaks into the label and manufactures ranking skill that is not there.

publications.title: Pretraining Buys Short-Horizon Direction: A Randomly-Initialized Control for Frozen Temporal Representations
publications.authors: A. Gumber, A. Batra, H. Dehra, S. Gumber, N. Batra, A. Khandelwal, K. Thukral
publications.summary: An untrained twin matches a trained JEPA on volatility; pretraining adds only one to two hours of directional signal.

publications.title: The Wrong Clock for Transaction Streams: Why Equal-Time Windows Fail as Trading Thins
publications.authors: A. Gumber, S. Gumber, T. P. Singh, P. V. Garg, I. Shekhar
publications.summary: A volume clock adds 5.1 points of direction accuracy over equal-time windows across 14 NASDAQ ITCH sessions.

publications.title: Monitoring a Volatility-Targeted Loss Limit: A Case Study in Estimator-Induced Miscalibration
publications.authors: A. Gumber, S. Gumber, P. V. Garg, I. Shekhar
publications.summary: Range-based volatility estimators breach a loss limit at 1.9× its design rate; test-martingale monitoring catches it.

publications.title: Do Scalar Summaries of Foundation-Model Embedding Geometry Improve Volatility Forecasting? A Calibrated, Leakage-Aware Audit
publications.summary: A deflation cascade shows that in-sample geometry signals survive certification under none of seven encoders.

publications.title: Faithful Is Not Interpretable: Sparse Features, Circuits, and Robustness in Frozen Audio Encoders
publications.authors: A. Batra, A. Khandelwal*, A. Gumber*, K. Thukral*
publications.summary: SAEs and transcoders on seven audio encoders reach R² 0.998 yet correlate only 0.12 with monosemanticity.

publications.title: Where to Read a Frozen Audio Encoder: Objective-Induced Geometry and Zero-Label Layer Selection
publications.authors: A. Batra, A. Khandelwal*, A. Gumber*, K. Thukral*
publications.summary: Label-free layer selection recovers 24 to 38 points lost to final-layer readout and cuts low-resource ASR CER by up to 23.9%.

publications.title: Adaptive Trimodal Fusion for Mental-Health Symptom Classification in Memes
publications.summary: A 1.7M-parameter trimodal head over frozen CLIP and MentalBART; 0.707 Macro-F1 on AxiOM with about 70× fewer trainable parameters.

publications.title: Graph-Based Cross-Modal Learning for Drug-Target Affinity Prediction
publications.authors: A. Attri, J. Khemani, A. Gumber, A. Gupta
publications.summary: A heterogeneous GNN fusing molecular and ESM-2 protein graphs; 14.95% lower MSE on KIBA cold-drug.

publications.title: DentalNet: Geometric Aware Multi-View Transformer for Occlusion Grade Prediction in Dental 3D Scans
publications.authors: A. Batra*, A. Gumber*, V. Sharma, R. Sardana, T. Tripathi, A. Gupta
publications.summary: 2D/3D cross-attention over intraoral views and 3D scans for IOTN-DHC occlusion grading at 67% F1.

publications.title: SocialDF: Benchmark Dataset and Detection Model for Mitigating Harmful Deepfake Content on Social Media Platforms
publications.authors: A. Batra, J. Khemani*, A. Gumber*, A. Kumar*, A. Jain, S. Gupta
publications.summary: A real-world deepfake benchmark with a multi-agent LLM detector that integrates fact-checking.

publications.title: Who Convinced Whom? Tracing How LLMs Change Their Minds in Multi-Agent Systems
publications.authors: A. Batra, A. Khandelwal, J. Khemani, K. Thukral, A. Gumber, D. F. Lim, U. Kumar, P. X. Tan
publications.summary: MAD Bench, 2,400 questions: multi-agent debate raises unanimous wrong answers by 3.1 to 7.4 points, and we trace who moved whom.

founder.name: StarkVision
founder.description: A 20-member student AI/ML research collective at IIIT-Delhi. Our work spans an ICML 2026 Spotlight, a TMLR journal paper, EMNLP 2026 Industry Track, CVPR 2025 Demo Track and a run of ICML and NeurIPS workshop papers. I set research direction, design experiments and mentor juniors from idea to acceptance; I was technical lead on our NCIIPC AI Grand Challenge entry, which became NivionAI.

about.bio: I work on what deep models actually learn, and on making that useful and trustworthy on real data: vision, language, audio, medicine and especially markets and data that arrives over time. I have traded markets since I was 16, which is probably why I distrust any backtest that looks too good.
about.credentials: Computer Science and Artificial Intelligence at IIIT-Delhi · GPA 8.91/10 · 2023–2027 · thesis with Prof. Anubha Gupta (SBILab) · research intern at SHIBA AI · collaborating with the University of Vienna · previously ML intern at S&P Global.
